name: file-grid
description: A folder of many files drawn as a grid of small squares, one per file: which ones Claude has opened (filled row by row), which were boiled down to a summary, and where the matches are (found or missed).

title.description: the label above the grid, e.g. `invoices/ · 500 files`

total.description: how many files (squares); should equal cols × rows

read.description: files Claude has opened, filled row by row from the top left; counts and grows between steps (use whole rows: a multiple of cols)

faded.description: of those, how many were boiled down to a summary (compaction), from the top left; a multiple of cols

hits.description: the files that hold a match, by column and row (0-based)

state.description: found: the match was reported; missed: it was there but not reported

stat.description: text after the counted number of opened files, e.g. `of 500 files opened by Claude`
